_doc: Letters from the Enclosure's solicitors (Leases). {lease}, {amount}, {stage}, {day}, {mx} {player} (Mr / Ms and your name) are filled in; one letter of each kind per lease waits at a time.

talk.hello: Lots from the Enclosure's estate. All real land, all previously fenced, all now someone else's problem. May I offer you a biscuit?
talk.lot: Take a look. Do ask if you want anything explained. Do not ask what happened to the previous tenant.
talk.open: Bidding opens at the reserve. Raise by a step, raise boldly to frighten the weak, or sit on your hands.
talk.raised: Another voice. The room shifts in its seat.
talk.won: Sold. The solicitor will write. He is always writing.
talk.lost: Sold to someone else. The land was not impressed either way.
talk.commissioned: The contractors have taken the cheque and a flask of tea. Give it a season.

welcome.from: Pringle, Pringle and Hargreaves, solicitors to the Enclosure (in liquidation)
text: Dear {mx} {player}. We write to confirm that {lease} is now yours, for {amount}, and that the keys, the gate and the keepers' grievances have been passed to you.
Upkeep will be taken from your purse each week. We would remind you that the land is held in trust for nobody in particular. Yours faithfully.
This is to acknowledge your payment of {amount} towards the upkeep of {lease}, taken as arranged.
The Enclosure's solicitors would like you to know that they find this surprising.
We were unable to take {amount} for the upkeep of {lease} when it fell due. The contractors will wait. The contractors are not patient.
The Enclosure would hate for the gate to be shut on you a second time. Do fill your purse.
FINAL NOTICE. The upkeep of {lease} is weeks behind. Three more missed weeks and the lease reverts to the Enclosure, which has not yet got round to dying.
Rewilding stops while you are in arrears. The land will keep its stage, and its grudges.
With regret we write to say that {lease} has reverted to the Enclosure for want of upkeep. The gate is shut again and the sign is back up.
The land keeps whatever you did to it. We have not yet worked out how to charge for that.
A contractor reports that {lease} is now {stage}. He has attached a photograph. It is mostly of a bird.
We enclose the invoice for your records. You will find it is already paid.
